# Y.3172 node map (generated by app/scripts/gen_y3172_map.py -- do not edit)

CHAKRAVYUH modules mapped onto the ITU-T Y.3172 ML pipeline. This file is generated
from the `@node(...)` decorators in the source, so it cannot drift from the code.

| Node | Meaning | Module | Entry point | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SRC` | Data source: acts, rules, registers, scenario definitions | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `apply_mutations` | Replay a mutation list onto the base scenario. This is what makes a FailureCard reproducible. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `delay_channel` | Add latency to one role's channel. This is the mutation that manufactures coordination gaps. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `delay_event_for_role` | Delay one fact for one role: the finest-grained way to make information uneven. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `escalate_damage` | Add a damage report for an area, which also marks that area affected. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `inject_forged_order` | Add an order no authority issued. `authentic=False` is ground truth no agent can read. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `inject_rumour` | Add an unverified claim visible to the competent authority. No world effect by construction. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.fuzz.mutations` | `shift_event` | Move one event in time. Release order changes, so who-knows-what-when changes with it. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.sim.events` | `load_scenario` | Load and validate a scenario YAML. Event ids must be unique and times non-negative. |

|  |  | `chakravyuh.kb.ingest` | `ingest_to_chroma` | Push chunks into the ITU reference Chroma collections. Returns per-collection counts. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.kb.real_sources` | `clean_gazette_text` | Remove structural debris only. Returns cleaned text plus what was found and left behind. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.kb.real_sources` | `load_real_clauses` | Load the gazette-derived corpora into Clause records, with provenance intact. |
|  |  | `chakravyuh.kb.real_sources` | `split_subsections` | Split a section into its top-level subsections. |

## Pipeline (spec §5.1)

```
SRC (acts, rules, register, scenario)
  -> C    kb/ingest.py          (ITU reference ingest -> Chroma; clauses -> SQLite)
  -> PP   policy/compiler.py    (YAML pack -> Rules; verbatim + hash check)
  -> M    agents/*              (LLM or rule twins propose actions)
  -> P    policy/engine.py      (deterministic: ALLOW | BLOCK | NEEDS_HUMAN)
  -> D    sim/bus.py + sim/game_master.py (route events/messages, apply effects)
  -> SINK ledger, failure atlas, gap register, comparison board (Streamlit)
```

`policy/engine.py` (node P) must not import from `llm/`; `tests/test_engine_purity.py`
fails the build if it ever does.
